title: Enforce app_metadata-only RLS and revoke PUBLIC execute on SECURITY DEFINER
context_summary: Supabase Security Advisor flagged user_metadata references in RLS and unsafe ::bigint casts.
observation: End users can mutate user_metadata via Auth APIs, and non-numeric strings throw 22P02.
verified_action: Read server-signed app_metadata only with regex-guarded bigint casts and revoke EXECUTE on SECURITY DEFINER functions from public/anon/authenticated.
